description: "The Queen's Matrimonial Ladder" by William Hone is a satirical illustrated pamphlet written in the early 19th century.
longDescription: This work is a political commentary on marriage and the royal affairs of the time, reflecting the societal norms and expectations surrounding marriage, especially within the context of the British monarchy.

authorInfo.bio:
William Hone (1780–1842) wrote The Queen's Matrimonial Ladder
A National Toy, With Fourteen Step Scenes; and Illustrations in Verse, With Eighteen other Cuts. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
